name: GitHub
description: Official GitHub MCP server, hosted at api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/. Defaults to a curated read toolset — repositories, issues, pull requests, actions and code search — with the server-side readonly switch on. Write tools (create a pull request, push, workflow dispatch, comments) need an explicit change of this entry and keep exec permission, so a run must pass the permission gate to use them.
auth: A GitHub personal access token in the Authorization header, as an {env:GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN} reference; export the variable in the environment that runs Core. Never paste the token into mcp.json.
cost: No per-call charge from GitHub. A token with broad scopes can act on the account; the template keeps X-MCP-Readonly=true and a read-only tool list.
requires: Network access to api.githubcopilot.com and a personal access token.
verified: 2026-11-01 against github/github-mcp-server docs/remote-server.md: URL https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/, Bearer PAT authorization, X-MCP-Toolsets / X-MCP-Tools / X-MCP-Readonly headers, /readonly URL modifier, per-toolset URLs under /mcp/x/{toolset}. Live handshake NOT_RUN: it needs a token, and no token on this machine was used.
limitations: The include list is the curated read set; a name the server does not report is simply absent, and the registry shows which tools were actually discovered only after the first call.
X-MCP-Toolsets is applied by the server; Core's include list is a second, local filter.
An unknown tool name in X-MCP-Tools is a server error, so the template filters locally and leaves the toolset header coarse.
